decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, Aerial View of Site, Site Plan, Letter, Tennis Court Lighting Design-18 pages, Aerial View of Site (photo) received 10/02/14.  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - On completion of the tendering process, details of the lighting shall be submitted to the London Borough of Hounslow for approval in writing. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - On completion of the installation, details of the lighting alignment shall be submitted to the London Borough of Hounslow for approval in writing. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and any adjustment shall be completed within one month of the approval.
Condition : 5 - The boundary hedge shall be maintained at a height of at least 2.0m as measured from the tennis courtside of the hedges.
Condition : 6 - The floodlighting, hereby permitted, shall not be operated after 9.30pm at night.
Condition : 7 - The level of illumination of the floodlighting hereby permitted shall not exceed TPA 300 lux
description: Installation of floodlights on two tennis courts (12 floodlight columns)
